final_message:
I fixed the following issues in the source code to make the test suite pass and ensure the functions behave as their docstrings specify:

- In billing.py, I changed billable_blocks to raise ValueError for negative minutes and to always round up partial blocks instead of using round().
- In schedule.py, I fixed add_slot to avoid using a mutable default argument. It now uses None and creates a new list each call, so separate calls do not share state.
- In timeutil.py, I fixed parse_duration to support all the documented formats (e.g., "1h", "45m", "1:30", bare numbers) and to raise ValueError only if none match.

No changes were made to tests or other files.
